stem: Meera is preparing salt water for a science activity at home in Jaipur. She adds spoonfuls of salt to 100 cm³ of water at room temperature, stirring after each spoonful. After a while, she notices that no matter how long she stirs, some salt stays at the bottom of the glass. What has happened to the water?

options.text: The salt has reacted with the water and formed a new substance.
The water has reached its solubility limit, so extra salt remains undissolved.
The water has evaporated, leaving the salt behind.
The salt particles have become too large to dissolve.

teacher.key_rationale: Once the maximum amount of solute has dissolved in a fixed quantity of solvent, further solute stays undissolved even with more stirring; this matches option B. The other options describe processes (reaction, evaporation, particle size) that do not occur here.
